name: crews
description: Crews plans and enforces delegation to task specific Claude Code subagent seats. An independent project for Claude Code, not affiliated with Anthropic.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Optional. Enables the live TypeSafe judge. Leave empty to run with the judge off.

inline_budget_enabled.title: Enable the inline execution budget
inline_budget_enabled.description: When true, the hook denies Bash after the inline budget is spent until crew_plan allocates more execution.

inline_budget.title: Inline execution budget
inline_budget.description: Counted execution calls allowed per turn before crew_plan is required. Used only when the inline budget is enabled.

seat_guard_mode.title: Seat guard mode
seat_guard_mode.description: block denies a generic or unplanned seat dispatch; advise only warns.
